steps: Pick the integer km k = ceil(distance of the 10th nearest place); GET maxDistanceKm=k and maxDistanceKm=k-1
expected: types=peak&types=lake → total 45 (34+11), every item peak or lake, items = total — API response
difficulty 2..2 → only difficulty 2 and total = local row count with difficulty 2; 1..1 likewise (inclusive ends) — API response

maxDistanceKm=k includes every place with distanceM ≤ k×1000 (equals the unfiltered subset) and k−1 drops exactly the places with distanceM in (k−1)×1000 < d ≤ k×1000; `total` equals the returned count — API response
Combined filters = intersection of the three single-filter result sets; total = its size — API response
